subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & audit evidence next steps (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Doherty <jane.doherty@acmehealth.com>, security@acmehealth.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & audit evidence next steps (Acme Health)

Hi Jane / Acme Security team,

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to walk through your upcoming SOC 2 timeline and evidence needs. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

Summary of pain points & goals:
- Audit window: you’re looking to start fieldwork w/c 2026-12-06 and need a 30-day evidence window before the auditor’s on-site.
- Evidence scope: SOC 2 Type II report, pen test summary, access to (redacted) audit logs for the evaluation period, retention policy confirmation, and executed DPA.
- Data residency: production data stays in us-west-2; you require an SOC 2 attestation and KMS-backed key controls.

What Redwood can provide (today):
- SOC 2 Type II snapshot (PDF) and summary of our control environment.
- Penetration test executive summary (redacted) + vendor attestation.
- Time-bound, read-only access to a secure evidence folder for your auditor (we control link expiry and IP whitelist).
- DPA template and standard security addendum; we can route to your legal team or sign via DocuSign.

Immediate next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll upload the SOC 2 snapshot and pen test summary to a secure Drive folder and share a short-lived link (attached).
2) Please confirm auditor name and email so we can grant read-only access (and whether they need IP restriction).
3) Your team to confirm the exact evidence window required (start/end dates) — we suggest granting a 30-day window ending right before on-site work begins.
4) Agree DPA redlines or indicate if you prefer us to initiate via DocuSign.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_snapshot.pdf (summary), redwood_pen_test_summary.pdf (executive summary)

If helpful, I can draft a one-page Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with dates and owners (I find that speeds up procurement).

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the Drive link in one email.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Jane Doherty <jane.doherty@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 16:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & audit evidence next steps (Acme Health)

Thanks Marissa — this is great and exactly what we discussed. A few clarifying points: 

- Auditor: Crowne Audit Services (auditor@crowneaudit.com). Please provision read-only access for them and set the expiration to 12/08/2026.
- Evidence window: we need logs and config for the period 2026-09-01 to 2026-10-31.
- DPA: we’ll send redlines to your legal team, but please go ahead and start the DocuSign flow so we have a record.

Also: do you have a short checklist we can hand the auditor to explain what’s in the Drive folder (mapping of files to controls)? That would be very helpful.

Appreciate you moving quickly on this.

— Jane
Director, Security & Compliance | Acme Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Doherty <jane.doherty@acmehealth.com>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & audit evidence next steps (Acme Health)

Hi Jane / Tom — thanks for the quick follow. Per your requests above, we’ve done the following: 

1) Drive link (read-only, auditor access): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/ACME-REDACTED (expires 2026-12-08, IP restriction available on request)
2) Uploaded files: redwood_soc2_snapshot.pdf, redwood_pen_test_summary.pdf, acme_evidence_access_instructions.txt (includes a file-to-control mapping checklist).
3) Evidence window: we will prepare logs and configuration exports for 2026-09-01 -> 2026-10-31 and stage them in the folder by 2026-11-12.
4) DocuSign: started standard DPA flow (DocuSign ID: 0A1B2C3D-ACME-DPA) — legal (Neha) will coordinate any redlines.

Next short-term asks for Acme: 
- Please confirm auditor email (we have auditor@crowneaudit.com) and whether they require a VPN or IP whitelist.
- Confirm whether you want AWS KMS key policy language we shared included in the DPA.

Internal notes: Neha / Rishi — please review the Drive folder and pen test summary; we should redact any PII before granting auditor access and confirm KMS language for the DPA. Monica / Vivek — can you confirm 30-day evidence export schedule and the owner for on-call access during fieldwork?

Attachments: redwood_soc2_snapshot.pdf; redwood_pen_test_summary.pdf; acme_evidence_access_instructions.txt

Thanks — I’ll set a reminder to follow up on 11/12 after we stage the logs.

Best,
Marissa
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>

- Approve 30-day read-only access for auditor (expire 2026-12-08).
- Rishi: please review pen test summary for PII and flag anything to redact by EOD 11/09.
- Neha: I’ll route Acme redlines when they come in; happy to sync 30m if needed.

Marissa: I’ll add the MAP draft to the Drive folder by EOD and assign owners for each line item.
